description: The instrument list — the sound palette: every instrument doseedo can PLAY YOUR NOTES on (doseedo_render_midi) — orchestral strings, brass and winds, guitars, basses, keys, drums and percussion, and World instruments (koto, sitar, banjo, pedal steel, tabla, congas…). Each entry gives the EXACT render call (`call`: instrument, plus timbre_preset where one is needed — a koto is the acoustic_guitar model with the koto timbre), its playable range in concert MIDI pitch, whether it plays chords, its presets (pizz, muted, sax registers…) and a demo render. No args → the whole catalog; query:"warm low brass" / family / pitches:[…] (instruments whose range holds them) / chords:true narrow it; id:"cello" → one instrument in full. Read-only, free, no key needed — read it before writing a part.

chords.description: true = only instruments one player can play chords on.

id.description: One instrument (id, alias or label, e.g. "cello", "upright bass", "koto") → its full entry: every preset with its own call and range, transposition, aliases, demo, page.

pitches.description: MIDI pitches the part uses (concert, 60 = C4) — only instruments whose range holds every one.

query.description: What the part needs, in words: an instrument ("trumpet"), a family ("woodwinds"), a technique ("pizzicato", "muted") or a register ("low", "bright"). Ranked best-first.

name: doseedo_instruments
title: Instrument catalog (the sound palette)
